notes:
Fixes from the latest round of beta testing.

- Renaming a card after plugging it in no longer mixes up which device it's assigned to
- When the internet is too unstable to upload, SafeStore says so and keeps re-checking Dropbox on its own
- A second card from the same camera goes into the next free slot, and installer disk images aren't offered as cards
- Cards only show Verified once their backup check has finished
- The transfer page stays put when you press Start backup
